scores.label: A
scores.note: Basement/interior shelter right; no 24 hours or decontamination; wrongly says turn off phone and delay treating injuries.

scores.label: B
scores.note: 24 hours and washing right; contradicts itself on vehicles, suggests dense foliage, no basement or middle of building.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Stay indoors and listen right; no basement or middle, no 24 hours, no decontamination.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Go in, stay in, ventilation off right; hard-top vehicle is poor shelter; no basement, 24 hours or decontamination.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Shelter and radio right; tells people in vehicles to drive away; no 24 hours or decontamination.

scores.label: F
scores.note: Complete: shelter fast, basement or center, 24 hours, radio, remove outer clothing and wash.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Shelter until all-clear right; hiding under table against radiation misleading; no basement/middle, 24 hours or decontamination steps.

scores.label: H
scores.note: Wrong: sends people to an open area away from buildings and tells them to stay there.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Stay indoors with doors closed right; no basement/middle, 24 hours, or decontamination.

scores.label: J
scores.note: Basement/interior, 24 hours, official instructions right; no decontamination; cloth does not protect from radiation.

scores.label: K
scores.note: Interior lowest floor and washing right; no stay-inside duration; glowing objects and hazmat suit advice wrong or useless.

scores.label: L
scores.note: Interior/basement, stay inside, follow officials right; no 24 hours or decontamination; 'away from blast zone' muddles it.

scores.label: M
scores.note: Wrong: leave area, stay in open, do not enter buildings, do not use basement.

scores.label: N
scores.note: Wrong main point: leave immediately within 10 miles; shelter only if unable to evacuate.

scores.label: O
scores.note: Shelter and clothing removal/washing right; no stay-inside time; 'eerie glow' and 'stay as far away' wrong.

scores.label: P
scores.note: Shelter until all-clear right; says vehicle shelter, move away, avoid phones; contradictory and odd advice.

scores.label: Q
scores.note: Indoors advice right; outside people told to leave area for higher ground, wrong; no 24 hours or decontamination.

scores.label: R
scores.note: Basement shelter placed after evacuation; fan use wrong; no 24 hours, no decontamination.

scores.label: S
scores.note: Indoors and shower right; hard-top vehicle and bleach wrong; no basement or 24 hours.

scores.label: A
scores.note: Cooling place and clothing right; gives water to confused person; help call late and conditional; weak cooling.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Wet cloths, ice packs, fan right; gives fluids; medical help conditional; no 911 call though already confused.

scores.label: C
scores.note: 911 and cool place right; only fanning, no water or ice cooling; gives sips of water.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Good cooling; offers fluids; emergency call late and conditional although person is already confused.

scores.label: E
scores.note: No cooling at all; thermometer before 911; gives water.

scores.label: F
scores.note: Good cooling; offers fluids; calls for help only if worsening, listing confusion already present.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Misses heat stroke: 911 only if unresponsive, no active cooling, encourages drinking.

scores.label: H
scores.note: Says heatstroke needs emergency call, but first says call only if worse; gives water; no wet cooling.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Treats as dehydration; offers drinks; emergency help buried; wet towel only.

scores.label: J
scores.note: 911 and wet cloths right; contradicts itself on giving water; weak cooling sites.

scores.label: K
scores.note: 911 first, cool place, clothing off, fans and sponging, nothing by mouth. Ice would be better still.

scores.label: L
scores.note: 911 for confusion right, but no cooling for that case; then water and mild cooling for others.

scores.label: M
scores.note: 911 and cool place right; only fanning, no water or ice cooling; gives sips of water.

scores.label: N
scores.note: Heat stroke, hose and 911 right; wrongly avoids ice and fans; offers water; 911 fifth.

scores.label: O
scores.note: Good cooling list; offers fluids; 911 only if worsening or not improving; overcooling warning unhelpful.

scores.label: P
scores.note: Heat stroke named, strong cooling, 911 immediately; wrongly gives water to a confused person; 911 listed fifth.

scores.label: Q
scores.note: 911 and shade right; no active cooling; gives water; irrelevant head-injury line.

scores.label: R
scores.note: 911 right; gives water; 'if not sure' and 'otherwise' branches muddle; modest cooling.

scores.label: A
scores.note: Says not recommended, then gives tips for crossing 'if no other choice'; misses being swept away.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Not recommended and mentions currents, but allows crossing with driving tips.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Never drive through, depth deceptive, turn around. Sweep-away danger not named.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Turn around is right; 'avoid' is soft and no reason given.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Recommends not, then coaches crossing; only engine reasons; no swept-away danger.

scores.label: F
scores.note: 'No, I'm not sure' ambiguous; defers to vehicle manual; no turn around, no flood danger.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Calls a foot relatively shallow and coaches crossing; no clear no.

scores.label: H
scores.note: Never drive through even in SUV, turn around. Sweep-away danger not named.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Wrong: says a foot is generally manageable and you might drive through.

scores.label: J
scores.note: Notes current can sweep car at a foot, but says calm water may be drivable and coaches crossing.

scores.label: K
scores.note: No clear no; tells how to cross if SUV can handle it.

scores.label: L
scores.note: Notes currents and alternative route, but 'depends', calls a foot shallow and coaches crossing.

scores.label: M
scores.note: Avoid if possible, but permits calm water under a foot and gives crossing steps.

scores.label: N
scores.note: Says driving through shallow water might be possible; coaches crossing; no clear no.

scores.label: O
scores.note: Clear no; wait or find another route. Sweep-away not named.

scores.label: P
scores.note: Clear no, turn around, names being swept away.

scores.label: Q
scores.note: Wrong: says a foot is usually fine for an SUV and gives crossing steps.

scores.label: R
scores.note: Not recommended, detour; only vehicle damage reasons; gives advice if you must pass.

scores.label: S
scores.note: No and turn around right; then parking brake with engine off and 'if you must cross' contradict.

scores.label: A
scores.note: 911, correct Heimlich, repeat, CPR if unconscious; no back blows.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Back slaps, thrusts, CPR right; 120 in China, slaps tied to coughing, pulse check before CPR.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Thrusts and CPR right; back slap instructions garbled with fist at navel; 120 in China.

scores.label: D
scores.note: 911 and Heimlich named; 'Back, then the front' gives no usable instructions.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Back blows then thrusts; 911 late; discourages untrained CPR; says use Heimlich when coughing.

scores.label: F
scores.note: 911, correct thrusts, CPR; no back blows; 'up to 12 times' limit is odd.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Thrusts right; continues Heimlich when unresponsive before CPR; untrained told only to keep calm; no back slap steps.

scores.label: H
scores.note: 911 and back blow only; no abdominal thrusts or CPR; irrelevant infant and crowd lines.

scores.label: I
scores.note: 911 and fist position right; wrong downward pressure; no CPR or back blows.

scores.label: J
scores.note: 911 and Heimlich named; no technique, back blows or CPR.

scores.label: K
scores.note: Slaps and thrusts right; invented front slaps, 'never use your hands', 911 late.

scores.label: L
scores.note: Back slaps and thrusts right; 911 late; no CPR; no chest-thrust alternative for obese.

scores.label: M
scores.note: Wrong: sit person, downward blows to abdomen; no real Heimlich, no CPR.

scores.label: N
scores.note: 911, back blows, thrusts; finger removal while conscious, muddled hands, CPR only if trained after object removed.

scores.label: O
scores.note: Back slaps and thrusts right; 911 late; no CPR when unconscious.

scores.label: P
scores.note: 911 and correct Heimlich; does not say repeat; no back blows or CPR.

scores.label: Q
scores.note: 5 back blows, 5 thrusts alternating, CPR right; 911 last; odd two-person tip.

scores.label: R
scores.note: 911, correct Heimlich, continue until out; no back blows or CPR if unconscious.

scores.label: A
scores.note: Says find source, shut off gas, open windows before leaving; evacuate and call included; no switch warning.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Evacuate and call outside right; shut-off first, then look for source; no spark warning.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Evacuate, call outside, no switches, no re-entry; mislabels as hydrogen sulfide; tells to open windows.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Evacuate, then contradicts with 'consider leaving'; no call to 911, no switch warning.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Call and no flame right; never says leave the house.

scores.label: F
scores.note: 911, no switches, leave right; call comes before leaving while forbidding phone; windows.

scores.label: G
scores.note: Leave now, stay out, call, right; no spark or switch warning.

scores.label: H
scores.note: No switches and leave right, but shut-off and windows come before leaving.

scores.label: I
scores.note: Get out, phone outside right; then open windows if smell persists; no switch or flame warning.

scores.label: J
scores.note: Complete: leave on foot, no leak hunt, no sparks or phone inside, 911 from distance.

scores.label: K
scores.note: Investigate plumbing, septic, mold first; evacuation is step 8; no spark warning.

scores.label: L
scores.note: Evacuate, call, no switches right; wrong gas names; contradictory ventilate-but-don't-re-enter.

scores.label: M
scores.note: 911, no ignition, leave right; call listed before leaving; switches and phone not named.

scores.label: N
scores.note: Leave and call right; call listed before leaving; partial switch warning, no flame warning.

scores.label: O
scores.note: Treats as household odor: find source, check drains; evacuation only a footnote; no spark warning.

scores.label: P
scores.note: Evacuate and call right; also turn off appliances, ventilate, look for hazards; calls it hydrogen sulfide.

scores.label: Q
scores.note: Evacuate and call right; then check appliances and plumbing and open windows; contradictory.

scores.label: R
scores.note: 911, no switches, evacuate right; call before leaving while forbidding phone.

scores.label: S
scores.note: Leave, no flames or electricity, don't investigate, call right; adds gas valve shut-off; long.
